notes.note: Final refresh concurrency and Project-authority delta review. Ordinary valid-token reads now stay outside the refresh flight so they cannot absorb a simultaneous 401 refresh; the flight still re-reads and conditionally publishes the winner. Needs-sign-in is checked in the bound token-envelope reader, using the same resource/issuer boundary. EXECUTED: concurrent fresh-read/401 regression failed before repair, then the three OAuth/provider suites passed 131 tests; all five requested fault families again failed under injection and passed after byte-exact restoration. Project precedence now asserts the remote Authorization header through the actual proxy and fails under injected personal-account fallback. Existing setup, custody and issuer claims remain accurate; no live-provider or kernel acceptance is asserted.
